title: Infotainment and function usability
summary: Feedback on infotainment and vehicle functions centers on usability and discoverability, with clear praise in one example but mostly ambiguous mentions that lack enough detail for firm sentiment classification.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the infotainment as intuitive and working well.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe vehicle functions and tech as complex, unintuitive, and difficult to learn or locate.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the main screen offers useful functions but poor guidance makes even simple features hard to find without dealer help.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention functions, displays, voice command support, unused features, and requests for more guidance, but many are too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
Several undetermined fragments are very short or incomplete, which prevents reliable interpretation.
Some undetermined examples hint at usability concerns, but their assigned sentiment does not allow them to be used as confirmed negative evidence.
